title: Value Probes: Learned Value Functions for Beam-Search Red Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2610.38526v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated red-team auditing of language models is an important way to evaluate safety-relevant behaviors. These audits implicitly search a tree of possible conversation pathways: at each turn an auditor model decides which conversation to continue, and an LLM judge scores the dialogue. We emphasize that this auditing procedure is a Markov decision process, where states are the conversation history, actions are candidate responses, and rewards are judge scores for the target behavior. By adopting this perspective, we introduce two major improvements to auditing. First, we propose adopting beam search for the audit rather than relying on the auditor alone. We then interpret the problem of finding states that are likely to lead to problematic behavior as value estimation. translated_title: 价值探针：用于束搜索红队测试的学习价值函数
translated_abstract: 对语言模型进行自动化红队审计是评估安全相关行为的重要方式。这些审计隐式地搜索一棵由可能对话路径构成的树：在每一轮中，审计模型决定继续哪个对话，并由一个LLM裁判对对话进行评分。我们强调，这一审计过程本质上是一个马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中状态是对话历史，动作是候选回复，奖励是裁判对目标行为的评分。通过采用这一视角，我们对审计提出了两项重大改进。首先，我们提出在审计中采用束搜索，而不是仅依赖审计模型本身。其次，我们将“寻找可能引发问题行为的状态”这一问题解释为价值估计。令人惊讶的是，我们表明该价值函数可以通过对目标模型激活进行线性探针（linear probing）来估计，以预测折扣未来奖励——这是一种我们……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将红队审计建模为马尔可夫决策过程，提出用束搜索替代单纯依赖审计模型，并通过线性探针从目标模型激活中学习价值函数以预测折扣未来奖励，从而更高效地找到可能引发问题行为的对话状态。
en_tdlr: This paper frames red-team auditing as a Markov decision process, proposes beam search instead of relying solely on the auditor model, and learns a value function via linear probes on the target model's activations to predict discounted future rewards, enabling more efficient discovery of conversation states likely to elicit problematic behavior.
